Pick the final pair: two twins of the best board entry, or the best one plus our own-pipeline hedge?
Decided: Two twins. On the private board the hedge would have scored 0.938, the twins 0.935 and 0.936.
Final: 5th on the public board (0.972), 39th of 4,020 on the private board (0.936)
Post-mortem: the private movies came from a different, sparser embryo. The borrowed base lost 0.032 to 0.041 from public to private; our own base lost only 0.019 to 0.024.
Post-mortem: our division layer added about 0.012 to 0.016 on either base and is the part of the work that carried over.
Post-mortem lesson: check what the hidden test set is made of on day one, build a clean held-out check first, and use the board only to confirm.
Both finals reproduce byte for byte from frozen copies.
